svg.title: From a question to evidence: seeds, anchors, and bounded hops
svg.desc: A question is normalized and split into content terms and structural words. Each content term runs one SEARCH weighted by IDF, and the seeds within 85% of the best become the anchors, while the structural words choose which hops to follow: supersedes, dependents or cites. A bounded expansion from the anchors, up to three supersession steps and one or two hops, gathers the evidence for the answer.
